# telnyx_whatsapp_business_account_settings (Resource)

The settings of a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA): its name, timezone and the webhooks that receive its WhatsApp events. Creating this resource adopts the settings of an existing WABA; destroying it leaves them as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage the settings of an existing WhatsApp Business Account. Destroy leaves
# them as they are.
data "telnyx_whatsapp_business_account" "main" {
  id = var.whatsapp_business_account_id
}

resource "telnyx_whatsapp_business_account_settings" "main" {
  whatsapp_business_account_id = data.telnyx_whatsapp_business_account.main.id
  name                         = "Acme Support"
  timezone                     = "America/Chicago"
  webhook_enabled              = true
  webhook_url                  = "https://example.com/webhooks/whatsapp"
  webhook_failover_url         = "https://backup.example.com/webhooks/whatsapp"
}

variable "whatsapp_business_account_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `whatsapp_business_account_id` (String) The whatsapp business account id.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the WhatsApp Business Account.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone identifier
- `webhook_enabled` (Boolean) Whether WhatsApp events are sent to the webhook URLs.
- `webhook_events` (Set of String) The WhatsApp events sent to the webhook URLs.
- `webhook_failover_url` (String) URL that receives the WhatsApp events of this account when webhook_url fails.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL that receives the WhatsApp events of this account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID of Whatsapp business account
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_whatsapp_business_account_settings.main <whatsapp_business_account_id>
```
